checks.name: robots.txt present & sane
checks.remediation: Serve a non-blocking /robots.txt that references your Sitemap.

checks.name: XML sitemap
checks.remediation: Publish /sitemap.xml and reference it in robots.txt.

checks.name: Link header for discovery
checks.remediation: Add a Link response header or HTML <link rel="api-catalog"|"describedby"> tag.

checks.name: Markdown content negotiation
checks.remediation: Serve text/markdown when the client sends Accept: text/markdown, or publish /index.md.

checks.name: /llms.txt
checks.evidence: 200 OK, 3017 bytes, has H1, has sections, has links
checks.remediation: Publish /llms.txt per llmstxt.org with an H1, summary, and ## sections of markdown links.

checks.name: Structured HTML (title, meta, JSON-LD, single H1)
checks.evidence: h1: 1, title: true, meta description: true, JSON-LD: true
checks.remediation: Ensure a single <h1>, <title>, meta description, and schema.org JSON-LD.

checks.name: Content Signals in robots.txt
checks.remediation: Optional: add `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-train=no, ai-input=yes` to robots.txt.

checks.name: Explicit AI bot rules
checks.evidence: 11 known AI agent(s) addressed in robots.txt
checks.remediation: Add explicit allow/deny rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, etc.

checks.name: Web Bot Auth key directory
checks.remediation: Optional: serve a JWKS-style key directory at /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory.

checks.name: API Catalog (RFC 9727)
checks.remediation: Optional: publish /.well-known/api-catalog if you expose programmatic APIs.

checks.name: MCP Server Card
checks.remediation: Optional: publish /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json if you expose an MCP server.

checks.name: Agent Skills index
checks.remediation: Optional: publish /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json if you offer programmatic skills.

checks.name: OAuth discovery metadata
checks.remediation: Optional: publish OAuth metadata if your site exposes an authenticated API.

checks.name: Machine-readable pricing
checks.evidence: JSON-LD offer on homepage (price, priceCurrency, billing period, price 0 only — paid plans not described): { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@graph": [ { "@type": "WebSite", "@id": "https://alo.asif.dev/#website", "url": "https://alo.asif.dev/", "name": "Alo", "description": "A priva
checks.remediation: Publish schema.org Offer / AggregateOffer JSON-LD on your pricing page with price, priceCurrency and the billing period, so an agent can answer "what does this cost?" without scraping prose.

checks.name: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)
checks.naReason: UCP is a product-catalogue standard — bonus only for a transactional site.
checks.remediation: Optional: UCP targets product catalogues. A few subscription plans don't need it.

checks.name: x402 Payment Required signal
checks.remediation: Optional: HTTP 402 with an x402 payload on monetized resources.

checks.name: Correct 404 handling
checks.remediation: Return a real HTTP 404 (not 200) for missing pages, with a body that names the site and links to your homepage, sitemap, and search so an agent can recover.

checks.name: Machine-readable API description
checks.remediation: Optional: publish an OpenAPI 3.1 document if your site exposes any programmatic endpoints.
checks.naReason: Content sites usually expose no programmatic API.

checks.name: Heading hierarchy & server-rendered text
checks.remediation: Server-render your main copy and break it into a real heading outline (one h1, then descriptive h2/h3 sections). Agents that don't execute JavaScript only see the HTML you ship.

specs.name: HTML Living Standard — headings and outlines

checks.name: HTTPS & canonical host
checks.evidence: final origin https://alo.asif.dev · http:// upgrades to https · www.alo.asif.dev serves its own copy (duplicate origin) · HSTS set
checks.remediation: Serve the site over HTTPS, 301-redirect http:// to https://, and redirect the www/apex variant to a single canonical host so agents don't index two copies of every URL.

checks.name: Content feed (RSS / Atom / JSON Feed)
checks.evidence: JSON feed at https://alo.asif.dev/feed.json (declared via <link rel="alternate">)
checks.remediation: Publish an RSS, Atom, or JSON Feed of new content and declare it in <head> with <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml">. Feeds give agents a cheap, dated changelog of your site that a sitemap doesn't.
